text: The sea wasn't always like this.
Too many things changed after the infection. Fishwalkers have appeared near the docks. I, uh, haven't been to that old place in a while, but... Now they're coming here, too.
Take care out there.
Yep... Thanks... Leave the rest to yourself. It'll patch me right up. Pick up all of these things you see, if 'yer don't wanna become fish food, heh. I just need a little rest...
While runnin' back home 'ere, I met one fish folk on the path. Grazed me, 'is all, but... Hey, lad, can ya fetch me this herb decoction? *He pointed at something on the table.*
Using diving equipment enhances your super attack. Each piece you find increases the number of crosses and the speed of the aiming game. Find all three!
Good luck, young fisherman.
The fishwalkers are terrorizing us. If you kill 10 of them, I will reward you.
You have killed K monsters. Come back when you reach 10.
Thank you! Here is your reward.
I need a Herbal Decoction. Can you bring me one?
Thank you! Here is your reward.
You don't have a Herbal Decoction. Find one and come back.
I feel terrible... Please, I need an antidote.
Thank you! You saved my life. Take this.
I don't have an antidote... I'm doomed.
Help me! I've seen monsters. Kill 15 of them and I'll reward you.
You did it! Here's a helmet.
You've killed some monsters. Need 15.

You're not from around here, are ya? *The man chuckled from sheer cruel irony, his laugh loud and piercing.* Tell ya what, kid. You don't wanna go there, and you definitely don't wanna get attacked by one. Run back where ya came from while you can.
